title: Zig Zag Duck Outdoor Laser Tag
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: You betcha! Since the laser guns only emit a beam of infrared light, there is nothing to harm you. And this is not a contact sport, so there is no special safety equipment to be worn. The main possible ways someone might be harmed while playing is either tripping or running into another player. We work hard to avoid the tripping by scouting out the playing area for any hazards.
